criteria.requirement: Implement xlsxwriter.records.Column(key,header,kind="auto",cell_format=None) and write_records(worksheet,start_row,columns,records,*,start_col=0,headers=True,missing="blank"). Use actual typed worksheet methods, never generic write for strings, so formula-looking and URL-looking text remain literal; only kind="formula" executes explicit formulas. Support strict number/boolean/text/datetime_utc/auto, None blanks, UTC feature, header aliases/formats and missing blank/raise. Prevalidate each complete row before its first cell, reject duplicate columns/oversize text/nonfinite values and bounds, detect write return failures, consume records once without whole-input buffering. Return count.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
